en.headline: Intangible Cultural Heritage Centre hosts free ICH Wonder Play fun day today
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department’s Intangible Cultural Heritage Office is running performances, workshops and interactive games at Sam Tung Uk Museum in Tsuen Wan from 11am to 6pm.
body: The Hong Kong Intangible Cultural Heritage Centre at Sam Tung Uk Museum in Tsuen Wan is holding a free ICH Wonder Play fun day today as part of the Hong Kong Museum Festival 2026.

Organised by the Intangible Cultural Heritage Office under the Leisure and Cultural Services Department, the event runs from 11am to 6pm and is themed around a nostalgic playground. Visitors can join walk-in activities including Cantonese music performances at 2pm and 4pm, and puppet shows at 2:45pm and 4:45pm on the outdoor front area.

Workshops such as wooden spinning top making, silk doll crafting and ding ding candy making demonstrations are also on offer, with some spots available on-site on a first-come-first-served basis 15 minutes before each session. Interactive stalls cover games like plane launcher, Cantonese word matching and herbal scent pouches.

The organisers said the programme lets participants experience Hong Kong’s intangible cultural heritage through watching, listening and hands-on activities. Admission is free and no advance booking is required for most walk-in items.

zh.headline: 三棟屋非遺中心今辦「非遺童遊」同樂日 免費入場
zh.dek: 康文署非物質文化遺產辦事處在荃灣三棟屋博物館舉辦，上午11時至下午6時設有廣東音樂、木偶戲表演及多項工作坊和互動遊戲。
body: 香港非物質文化遺產中心（位於荃灣三棟屋博物館）今日舉辦「非遺童遊」同樂日，作為香港博物館節2026活動之一，免費入場。
活動由康樂及文化事務署轄下非物質文化遺產辦事處主辦，時間為上午11時至下午6時，以懷舊遊樂場為主題。前地設有廣東音樂表演（下午2時及4時）及木偶戲表演（下午2時45分及4時45分），即場參加。
另有木陀螺製作、抽紗公仔及叮叮糖示範等體驗工作坊，部分名額預留即場報名，於該節開始前15分鐘在詢問處排隊領籌，先到先得。互動攤位包括飛機欖投投樂、粵語對對碰及中草藥香包等。
主辦單位表示，參加者可透過觀看表演、聆聽及親身動手，認識香港非遺。大部分即場活動無需預先報名。
